title: A Trip to Italy
text:
Last summer, my family took a trip to Italy. We flew to Rome on a Monday morning. The weather was warm and sunny every day. We visited the Colosseum and ate a lot of pasta.

On the last day, we took a train to Florence. The train was fast and comfortable. In Florence, we walked to a small market near the river. I bought a leather bag for my sister.

questions.text: Where did the family fly to?
How did the family travel to Florence?
Why did the family probably enjoy their days in Rome?
options: The weather was pleasant and they could go outside
They had to stay inside all day
They did not like the food

questions.text: What was the writer's feeling about the trip?
options: They were bored and wanted to leave early
They felt happy and had a good time
They were sad about the cost
They were afraid of the trains

paragraph_translations: Минулого літа моя родина поїхала в подорож до Італії. Ми полетіли до Риму в понеділок вранці. Погода була теплою і сонячною кожного дня. Ми відвідали Колізей і їли багато пасти.
В останній день ми поїхали потягом до Флоренції. Потяг був швидким і зручним. У Флоренції ми пішки дійшли до невеликого ринку біля річки. Я купив(ла) шкіряну сумку для сестри.
